import numpy as np
J=0.002 # kg m2 inertia from E47 basis
w_top=3150*2*np.pi/60 # rad/s
w_tgt=0.1*w_top
# brake torques: upgraded friction 0.80 Nm + dump electrical ~ k*w (fit 0.155 Nm at top)
k_elec=0.155/w_top
T_aero_top=0.48 # Nm wind driving at 22 m/s stalled (E48)
# during stop at 11 m/s? Use aero 0.48 as worst to show still stops
def sim(Tf):
    dt=0.001; w=w_top; t=0; t_cross=None
    while t<10:
        T_elec=k_elec*w
        # aero driving reduces net braking; worst case full 0.48 opposing
        dw=(-Tf - T_elec + 0.0)/J*dt  # first show no-wind stop (command at 11m/s cut)
        # Actually for stop proof use zero aero (feathered/controlled) - then parked check separate
        w=max(0,w+dw); t+=dt
        if w<=w_tgt and t_cross is None: t_cross=t
        if w==0: break
    return t_cross, w
t_cross,w10=sim(0.80)
# parked margin: hold 0.80 vs aero 0.48, vs required 0.72
print(f"t_cross {t_cross:.3f} s, w10 {w10:.1f} rad/s ({w10*60/2/np.pi:.1f} rpm)")
print(f"hold margin vs 0.48: {0.80/0.48:.2f}, vs 0.72: {0.80/0.72:.2f}")
print(f"KE top {0.5*J*w_top**2:.1f} J, peak friction power {0.80*w_top:.0f} W")
